items.q: That's why the great exponents of the blues, like T-Bone Walker and others are able to captivate audiences.

ctx.x: -- and have it come out pretty.

Right. Even if you're expressing the evil part of the blues, of which there are some evil parts of blues, you have to be able to express it with a mirth. That's why the great exponents of the blues, like T-Bone Walker and others are able to captivate audiences. It's because they can show
the mirth, the and comedy of the sadness of the blues. You see?
